create.name: Mayumi Pachkoski
create.bio:
Mayumi Pachkoski is an energy healer and certified Quantum-Touch instructor who works from her own salon, Beauty Within Skin Care, in Lutherville, just north of Baltimore, Maryland. A licensed esthetician with close to twenty years in holistic skin care, she came to energy work alongside her facial practice and now teaches Quantum-Touch at both the introductory Level 1 and the advanced Level 4, which the method once called Level 2.

Her hour-long energy sessions, in person or at a distance, draw on whatever suits the person in front of her: Quantum-Touch breath and life-force techniques, Reiki, Access Bars, methods adapted from hypnotherapy, and calming practices from Japanese wellness traditions. People come to her for stress, feeling stuck, relationship strain or a sense of lost direction, and she frames the work as complementary rather than a replacement for medical care. Her Quantum-Touch workshops run in short afternoon segments over two weeks, both at the salon and live online, and are aimed at bodyworkers, Reiki practitioners, estheticians and anyone wanting a structured grounding in energy healing; massage therapists can earn continuing-education hours for Level 1.

courses.title: Energy Healing Sessions
courses.description: One-hour sessions in her Lutherville salon or at a distance, combining Quantum-Touch, Reiki, Access Bars and calming Japanese practices around what the client brings, such as stress, feeling stuck or relationship strain.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1 Workshop
courses.description: The foundation Quantum-Touch training, taught in four afternoon segments in person or live online: breath and body-awareness techniques for focusing life-force energy, hands-on practice and self-healing methods. Massage therapists can claim continuing-education hours.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 4: Becoming Heart-Conscious
courses.description: The advanced workshop for those who have done Level 1, in four afternoon segments in person or online, reviewing the core techniques and working with heart and brain coherence, past experiences and manifestation.
